summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for generic AgentOps session initialization using the init() function and OpenTelemetry context. It differs semantically from peer_candidates which target specific framework integrations (Llama Stack, SwarmZero) and from the existing_skills which address web performance monitoring (CLS, script loading). No existing skill covers the core AgentOps init workflow with OpenTelemetry compliance. Peer candidates represent framework-specific variants, not overlaps with this generic initialization capability.
